name: September
objective: Carry race momentum into the festive season; lock 3-month memberships before the October–December dip; grow privates.
strategy:
57 Days to Diwali.

Commercial job: Carry race momentum into the festive season; lock 3-month memberships before the October–December dip; grow privates.

Newcomer: The 57-Day Proof (“Measure on day 1. Re-test before Diwali. Or your next month is free.”). A results promise is more persuasive than a bigger %, and the 20-class condition makes the guarantee rarely paid.

Winback: The Return Policy (“Come back within 7 days of your comeback class: 20% off and a bonus.”). A 7-day window keeps decisions fast.

Renewal: Festive Pause Button (“Three months at 18% off. Diwali and year-end travel covered.”). October–December are troughs; locking 3 Months now carries members through them.

Renewal: Private Matters (“Ten privates at 15% off, booked before the festive rush.”). Privates are Kwality's highest-value add-on (₹5.1L in Sep-2026); a pack sold before Diwali fills trainers' quiet October hours.
notes:
Moment: 57 Days to Diwali countdown (Thu 2 Sep → Thu 28 Oct): weekly countdown classes and a studio 'Diwali Fit Check' re-test day on Sat 23 Oct.
Build: new clients 44 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹5.3L; reactivation 36 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.1L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹4.8L; renewals ₹25.3L. First visits needed 147 vs 136 last year (1.08×); CRM leads needed 294 vs 189 last year.

items.detail: Set up The 57-Day Proof in Momence (2–30 Sep.): 1 Month Unlimited at 15% off (₹17,203) — a fitness check on day 1, coach check-ins, and a re-test before 28 Oct: 20+ classes and no improvement on 2 of 3 measures = your next month free.

Set up The Return Policy in Momence (All September.): 1 Month Unlimited (₹16,191) or a 12-class pack (₹15,750) at 20% off — a free comeback class first, and 1 bonus class if you buy within 7 days of it.
Set up Festive Pause Button in Momence (All September.): 3 Months Unlimited at 18% off (₹47,441) — unlimited freezes (used within 6 months) and a festive gift box.
Set up Private Matters in Momence (All September.): A 10-private pack at 15% off (₹44,625, list ₹52,500) — a posture and strength assessment in session one.
Brief the team on the 4 September offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch The 57-Day Proof to First-time clients.
Launch The Return Policy to Clients lapsed 61–365 days.
Launch Festive Pause Button to 1 Month and 3 Months renewers.
Launch Private Matters to Active members and private clients.
Run the month's moment: 57 Days to Diwali countdown (Thu 2 Sep → Thu 28 Oct): weekly countdown classes and a studio 'Diwali Fit Check' re-test day on Sat 23 Oct.

Weekly check: The 57-Day Proof: Day-1 checks done; October renewals of September joiners. | The Return Policy: Comeback classes → purchase within 7 days. | Festive Pause Button: 3M renewals and upgrades. | Private Matters: Packs sold; trainer utilisation.
Mid-month review against ₹39.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 242 renewals, 36 reactivations and 44 new buyers (147 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close September: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief October's offers.
